title: Bunkerhill raises $55M to scale agentic AI across health systems
slides: Bunkerhill raised $55M — but for what exactly?
It builds AI agents that act like hospital staff.
These agents don't just chat — they execute tasks.
Health systems can now automate clinical workflows.
Run one pilot in revenue cycle today.
thread_text:
1. $55M for what?

Bunkerhill just raised a $55M round. The product is AI agents that don't just talk — they execute hospital tasks.

2. These agents work like staff.

The agents simulate roles: nurses, administrators, coders. They don't assist — they replace workflow steps entirely.

3. Not chat — execution.

Each agent can log into systems, update records, generate bills. No human click needed after the trigger.

4. Health systems automate now.

Clinical workflows like prior auth or discharge summaries run end‑to‑end without a person touching the interface.

5. Test revenue cycle this week.

Pick one revenue cycle pain point. Ask your IT team to run a Bunkerhill pilot. What's stopping you?
